notes.title: I'm on Steam!
notes.content:
Whoo-hoo! I just published Broken Legends as coming soon! I never thought I would get this far! Any support for this game is appreciated. I am dedicating a lot to this game, so I hope you all like it. I thought I would make it this far. I hope I can release a good game, that you all will like. ...Hmm, this doesn't feel bold enough... Lemme try something...


[h1][b]BROKEN LEGENDS IS ON STEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEAM!!! whoo-HOOOOOOOOOOO!!!![/b][/h1] Also, check out my itch.io page [url=https://ethn-studios.itch.io/broken-legends]by clicking here.[/url] Remember to stay healthy during these crazy times! ːsteamthumbsupː
